sources: catalog/production/thomas-supplement-r1/brief-2026-11-19 (托马斯动作库补充-制作说明 item 7)

purpose.zh: 练前臂转动的力量，换手时手掌能转到位
purpose.en: Builds the forearm turning strength you need to place your hand when switching hands.

text.zh: 前臂贴住大腿不动，只把手掌翻过来
text.en: Forearm stays on your thigh, just turn your palm

text.zh: 握在哑铃一端，掌心朝上转到朝下，再转回来，一来一回算一次。
text.en: Hold one end of the dumbbell, turn palm up to palm down and back; that's one rep.

text.zh: 握得离重的那头越远越难，先握近一点。
text.en: The farther from the heavy end you hold, the harder; start closer.

commonErrors.en: Lifting your elbow off your thigh.

cautions.zh: 没有哑铃用锤子或水瓶也行
cautions.en: No dumbbell? A hammer or water bottle works.

thomasSupplement.camera: 正前方特写（看手掌翻转）
thomasSupplement.doseBrief: 2–3 组 × 每侧 10–12 次（一来一回算 1 次）
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief.
